title: Hausdorff measure under the dilation x ↦ ρx
statement: Hausdorff measure under the dilation x ↦ ρx. Let N, k ∈ ℕ and ρ > 0, and let H^k = μHE[k] be the Euclidean k-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N (Eucl N). The map φ(x) = ρx is a measurable embedding of ℝ^N, and φ is measure preserving from ρ^k·H^k to H^k. That is, φ_#(ρ^k H^k) = H^k: H^k(φ⁻¹B) = ρ^{−k}H^k(B) for every Borel set B, or equivalently H^k(ρE) = ρ^k H^k(E).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) ∧ MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))
